shm-period-factors.alt: Left: a block of mass m hanging from a spring of constant k, with T = 2π√(m/k); the period depends on m and k, not on the amplitude or g. Right: a simple pendulum of length ℓ at a small angle, with T = 2π√(ℓ/g); the period depends on ℓ and g, not on the bob's mass or the amplitude.
